summary: Stone lookout on Fairview Peak, Gunnison County, Colorado; build date 1911 or 1908-09 depending on source; restored 2008-2018; listed as standing.

facts.design: Stone cab built from rock on the site, mortared with native soil; wooden cupola removed in the 1960s, replica added in 2018

access.note: 2019 survey: door latched but not locked so hikers can take shelter. No closure notice was read; check with the Gunnison Ranger District.

events.note: Trail, telephone line and stone lookout house built 1908-09 under Ranger Jack Cammann, per Forest Lookouts. The Register gives 1911.
Register detail page gives 1911; its description says 1912
Forest Lookouts: found inadequate and abandoned for better sites, lightning a factor. Year is the end of its 1910-14 range. A 1919 guidebook describes a man stationed there in dry periods.
1960s: wooden cupola removed and building re-roofed to house radio equipment
Forest Service archaeologist Justin Lawrence led a major renovation; volunteers spent a week on the work
Register gives walls restored 2008-2009. Passport in Time and local volunteers spent a week; stonework stabilized the walls up to the roof; budget limits on further USFS work
Roof rebuilt, replica cupola added and windows replaced, per March 2019 survey ('last year')

notes_for_editor: Build date disagrees across sources and is left open: NHLR detail gives 1911, its description gives 1912, and Forest Lookouts gives plans c.1907 and construction 1908-09 under Ranger Jack Cammann. Staffing also disagrees: Forest Lookouts gives 1910-14 with abandonment, but a 1919 guidebook it quotes describes a man stationed there in dry periods; the abandonment year 1914 is the end of that range. Record height_m 274.3 equals 900 ft, which matches the trail's elevation gain from a search summary, not a structure height. It is omitted from facts; the record field should be checked. Record items not found in pages read and left out: the $500 FFLA grant (2008), the 2015 restoration and removal from the high-risk list. A search summary of Wikipedia mentions a 2015 cupola rebuild by Historicorps; not read, not used. NHLR gives registration December 7, 2007, but a chapter report says three lookouts including Fairview Peak were added to the register in the year it calls this year, with June dedications; that report's year was not confirmed in the text read. Access rests only on the 2019 survey; no current closure or rental notice was read. No photos added: NHLR mentions a July 2024 photo by Ian Roberts but no image URL was retrieved. Budget: six page reads and two web searches used.
